audio_strategy_rationale: Quiet-room and microphone checks cannot be confirmed without the user present. 'separate' is the safe lock: capture the screen silently, add narration in post. No take is lost to room noise.

scene1_coldopen: An agent is about to write a fact into another agent's memory.
This is the slot it wants to write to, and it is already contested.
Independence, reliability and recency - reported separately, never blended.
scene2_proof: The probe failed first. That is the honest version of this story.
Run max-flow naively on the echo graph and it returns two -
two citations that look like two independent sources.
They are not. They funnel through one shared origin.
Splitting every source node into an in-half and an out-half returns one.
One versus two is the only evidence the split does any work.
Both controls run before the service agrees to answer anything.
scene3_graph: The split is not hidden - it is the mechanism.
Max-flow over this graph counts vertex-disjoint chains,
which is Menger's theorem doing the work a heuristic would fake.
scene4_block: A single low-trust blog, echoed, tries to overwrite the region.
Independence one, against the incumbent's two.
The verdict is BLOCK. The status is REFUSED.
And it is still recorded - a refusal is an auditable event, not a silent drop.
The incumbent is untouched. Same claim, same value, same timestamp.
A gate that returns the string BLOCK while quietly promoting the loser
is strictly worse than no gate, because the receipt would say the right thing.
scene5_receipt: This is the exact text that ran - a single parameterised Cypher query,
through the read-only command, with the independence witness attached.
Replay re-executes it and diffs the result. It reproduces.
Recency drifts, because time moves. Nothing else does.
scene6_review: When the margin falls inside epsilon, the graph refuses to pretend.
The write is not allowed and not blocked - it is queued for a human.
Epsilon is zero point zero five, published by the engine, not by this console.
scene7_boundary: What this does not do: it does not decide which claim is correct.
It is admission control. The score is ordinal - a rank, never a probability.
It has no latency, throughput or accuracy numbers, because none were measured.
And removing the graph algorithms does not degrade the product.
